log: Two meshes, one island each, identical size 2x2x2 and identical centre (at 0.5,0.5,0.5), 44 triangles each: the two shapes occupy the same volume, so they are either coincident or nested; the evidence does not say which is inside.
44 triangles on a 2-unit cube suggests bevelled or chamfered corners, but that is inferred from the triangle count only; I called it 'bevelled' on shape and triangle count alone.
Colour names come from the material names (Orange, Blue), not from sampled colours: no colour data is reported for untextured materials. Material names are not listed in basis, per the instructions.
No function is supportable from the evidence, so both are named by shape and material colour only.
